title: The Undertow Where Unified Things Drift Apart

features.name: the-pull-that-teaches-difference
features.desc-on-touch: Everything unified above fractures here in the current. Measurement splits from language. Method diverges from meaning. The undertow doesn't destroy—it remembers that these were never the same thing.

features.name: divergent-languages-in-the-current
features.desc-on-touch: Words for the same thing, tugged in different directions. Speech fragmenting as it flows past. The archive can no longer hold them under one name.

features.name: the-knot-coming-undone
features.desc-on-touch: What was braided together at the Unified Measure is unravelling here. Each strand remembers it was always separate. The tug-and-release is not violent. It is gentle, inevitable.

features.name: the-currents-that-read-differently
features.desc-on-touch: The water moves in patterns no single observer can map. What was unified understanding has become a thousand local truths, each pulled by its own undertow.

features.name: the-light-that-breaks-into-spectrum
features.desc-on-touch: In the unified place above, all wavelengths moved as one. Here they are tugged apart. Each colour remembers it was always travelling alone.

inscription: things that learned they were one thing teach themselves how to become many again; the undertow is their classroom

file.name: Unified_Measure_Dissolution_Log_Night182.txt
file.note: How the archive learned that unification was always temporary. The current writes itself on water. Checksum: divergent at every reading.
